## The brief

The organisers' request, as the abstract.

::: {.abstract}
- A more communication-focused lecture in the afternoon, tentatively
  titled *Science Communication with and under AI*.
- A starting point only, to make my own.
- My experience during COVID-19, whether working with government bodies,
  the public, or fellow scientists, including building widely used R
  packages for the modelling community, could be the material.
- About 30 minutes.
:::

## Around it

Karolien Poels speaks before, on risk communication and uncertainty.
Andres Algaba speaks after, under the same title.

- [Infectious disease modelling in the age of AI](../keynote/index.qmd).

## Resources

### The pandemic

- [The epiforecasts COVID-19 dashboard][covid].
  Daily $R_t$ estimates and forecasts, 2020 to 2022.
- [EpiNow2][epinow2].
  The package behind them, used by public health agencies.
- [scoringutils][scoringutils].
  Forecast evaluation, used by the forecast hubs.

### Communities

- [epinowcast][epinowcast].
  Packages, a [community forum][forum], and a seminar series.
- [EpiAware][epiaware].
  The Julia organisation, and its
  [contributing guide](https://epiaware.org/contributing/).

### With and under AI
